pushB:incline-press.coach: Up one step: all three sets reached 12, past the top of 10.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Up one step: every set reached 12.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Stay at 4 kg: 15 on every set, go for 20, then up.

pushB:dips.coach: Stay at 30 kg: 8 is the bottom of the range, go for 12.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: Stay at 15 kg: 12 on every set, go for 15.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: 15 a side, go for 20.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time here: use your Pull A pulldown weight, 37.5 kg, and aim for 10.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you can row 10 times with 2 reps left, about 25 to 30 kg.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you can row 12 times with 2 reps left, about 12.5 kg, left arm first.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: pick a light rope weight you can pull 20 times with 2 reps left, about 10 to 15 kg.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: 15 a side today, go for 20.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can curl 12 times with 2 reps left, about 7.5 kg.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: start light, about 7.5 kg a hand, aim for 10 a leg with 2 reps left.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you can do 10 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 12 on every set, go for 15.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight you can do 15 times with 2 reps left, full stretch at the bottom.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: bodyweight, legs straight; bend the knees if form breaks before 10.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Machine, up one step: 12.5 kg gave 12 on every set on Thursday.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 8 on every set, go for 12.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg: there is no 7.5 kg setting and 10 kg gave 7, so go to failure past 15.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Stay at 30 kg: the second set gave 8, get 12 on both.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Stay at 25 kg: 10 on every set, go for 15.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Stay at 4 kg: 15 on Thursday, go to failure toward 20.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Stay at 37.5 kg, the stack step: 8 on every set, go for 10.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Up one step: every set reached 12.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 14 on every set, one rep from 15.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 12 on every set, go to failure toward 20.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: go to failure toward 20.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg: 10 on every set, go to failure past 12.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Up one step: 12 on every set on the empty sled, add the first plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Up one step on the cable: every set reached 10.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 12 on every set, go for 15.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 12 on both sets, go to failure toward 15.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 12 on every set, go to failure toward 15.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight: 12 on every set, go to failure toward 15.

cable-lateral.note: 5 kg is the top plate, lifted with no pin.
